title: Skill review question answers
description: answers.json. One entry per review question the contract asks, recording how the reviewer settled it. A phase cannot close while any of its questions is missing here, so this file is the evidence that the review covered its contract rather than a sample of it.

answers.description: Keyed by question id, which is the phase name and the question's position in the contract document.

question.description: The question text as it stood when answered. Kept so a later edit to the contract is visible as a mismatch rather than silently rewriting what the reviewer was asked.

evidence.description: A path, a path and line, or a command and its result. Required for every verdict: 'holds' is a claim about the skill exactly as much as 'violated' is, and an unevidenced pass is the failure this file exists to prevent.

finding.description: Set when a recorded finding is what settled the question, whether seeded by a scan or entered by the reviewer.
